param.name: presence_pct
param.label: Minimum presence fraction
param.help: Genes must have non-zero expression in at least this fraction of samples. (default: 0.60)

param.name: var_percentile
param.label: Variance percentile cutoff
param.help: Remove genes with variance below this percentile. (default: 40)

param.name: soft_power
param.label: Soft-thresholding power (0 = auto)
param.help: The soft-thresholding power β for adjacency function. 0 = auto-detect from scale-free topology. (default: 0)

param.name: min_module_size
param.label: Minimum module size
param.help: Minimum number of genes per co-expression module. (default: 50)

param.name: merge_cut_height
param.label: Module merging cut height
param.help: Modules whose eigengene correlation ≥ (1 - height) are merged. (default: 0.25)

param.name: max_block_size
param.label: Maximum block size
param.help: Maximum number of genes per block in blockwiseModules. Larger = more RAM. (default: 5000)

param.name: kme_threshold
param.label: kME threshold (|kME| cutoff)
param.help: Only retain genes with |module membership| above this value for network export. (default: 0.80)

param.name: cor_threshold
param.label: Module-trait correlation threshold
param.help: Only export modules with |r| ≥ this value to Cytoscape. (default: 0.60)

param.name: tom_percentile
param.label: TOM edge percentile cutoff
param.help: Only edges with TOM weight in the top (1 - percentile) fraction are exported. (default: 0.95)
